checkRuns.command:
git status --short | head -3; bun run check && bun run build 2>&1 | grep -i error
(PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 2
c=http://localhost:4701
curl -s $c/books/dracula | grep -o '<main.*</main>' | head -c 900; echo
curl -s -d 'name=+Bob&email=bad&message=short' $c/contact | grep -o '<main.*</main>'
curl -s -d 'name=Bob&email=a@b.co&message=0123456789012345678901' $c/contact | grep -o 'Thanks[^<]*'

kill $(ss -ltnp | grep 4701 | grep -o 'pid=[0-9]*' | cut -d= -f2); bun run check && bun run build 2>&1 | grep -ci error
(PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 2
curl -s -d 'name=Bob&email=a@b.co&message=0123456789012345678901' localhost:4701/contact | grep -o 'Thanks[^<]*'
curl -s localhost:4701/books/dracula | grep -o 'Rating[^<]*'
kill $(ss -ltnp | grep 4701 | grep -o 'pid=[0-9]*' | cut -d= -f2); ss -ltn | grep -c 4701

docs.source: https://docs.solidjs.com/llms.txt and the pages it links
